freshness_scope: prospective field outcomes are unopened; public occurrence context may already have been audited and is not treated as an independent confirmation outcome

explicit_exclusions.reason: Fresh v1 is restricted to the architecture's predeclared SENTINEL/DETACHED scope; opened development units cannot be recycled for promotion.

frozen_method_boundary.coarse_cell_assignment: On the frozen 100-m regular candidate grid, assign each candidate to a 50-by-50 fine-cell block relative to the declared frame grid origin; empty blocks are absent.
frozen_method_boundary.coarse_coverage_order: Build one row per non-empty coarse cell using integer block row/column and rank cells with MORTON_DYADIC_COVERAGE_ORDER_V1.
frozen_method_boundary.fine_order: Within each coarse cell rank only by the already-frozen family structural support, stable SHA-256 candidate-id tie break.
frozen_method_boundary.global_order: within_cell_structure_rank ASC -> coarse coverage rank ASC -> stable candidate hash ASC

comparators_to_freeze_before_execution.same_fine_frame_spatial_balance: MORTON_DYADIC_COVERAGE_ORDER_V1 applied directly to all fine candidate cells
comparators_to_freeze_before_execution.coverage_nonstructural: same frozen coarse coverage-cell order and same round-robin depth, but stable SHA-256 candidate-id ordering within each coarse cell
comparators_to_freeze_before_execution.nearest_known: NOT_DEFINED_FOR_SENTINEL because the frozen candidate-frame contract forbids a known-point local kernel when primary anchors are absent

prefix_curve.selected_count_rule: ceil(fraction * candidate count), minimum one when nonempty
prefix_curve.note: These are ranking diagnostics. External field-performance promotion still requires matched search effort and complete detection/non-detection logs.

source_failure_policy.failure_interpretation: unavailable source evidence, not a biological negative

execution_blocker.reason: All four fresh-SENTINEL units lack an upstream exact-site freeze provenance pin. The pinned aza3 v8 contract reports zero required slots frozen; CIR02/CIR06 have range-sector plans but exact localities are not yet frozen, while CIR12/CIR13 require the first P02-validated wild population before their exact locality can be frozen.
execution_blocker.next_legal_step: Complete the upstream aza3 exact-site freeze for CIR02/CIR06/CIR12/CIR13, including the P02 first-validated-population link for CIR12/CIR13; create and immutably pin the coordinate-free canonical range-sector provenance receipt; only then supply/open the private four-feature RFC7946 GeoJSON and freeze candidate/comparator orders.
